description: New Zealand v0 calibration authoring contracts. Observed values and source lineage live only in Chronicle. WFF and IWTC national counts have cell-pinned identities; the remaining series-level rows require expansion. Every row needs a reviewed Frame column and period bridge before activation; no table-level placeholder is itself a calibration target. Treasury DistributionExplorer full-entitlement outputs, official Budget reform scores, and administrative expenditure totals remain external validation evidence rather than solver targets.

target_references.name: stats_nz_population_by_age_sex_region
target_references.notes: Primary age-band x sex x region population surface. Chronicle must supply one dimension- and region-pinned fact per selected cell, the complete region roster, uncertainty, and a reviewed bridge from the 30 June 2025 reference date to the 2026-27 build basis.

target_references.name: stats_nz_population_by_single_year_age_sex
target_references.notes: National single-year age x sex cells constrain the age tail. The profile must prove reconciliation with the region surface rather than double-counting inconsistent totals.

target_references.name: stats_nz_census_households_by_composition
target_references.notes: Household and family composition is the structural control for WFF family assembly. Chronicle must expand the published categories and supply a reviewed 2023-to-2026 basis before activation.

target_references.name: stats_nz_census_households_by_tenure_region
target_references.notes: Each tenure x region cell needs its own deterministic indicator binding. Market-rent amounts are validation/input evidence for Accommodation Supplement, not household-count calibration rows.

target_references.name: ird_taxable_income_people_by_band
target_references.notes: Administrative count backbone. Chronicle must emit one income-band fact and reviewed prepared indicator per cell; the target basis must be advanced explicitly to the build period.

target_references.name: ird_taxable_income_total_by_band
target_references.notes: Dollar companion to the count bands. Activation requires a destination-NZD taxable-income column with a reviewed donor bridge; US-dollar values may never be compared directly with NZD thresholds.

target_references.name: ird_wage_salary_people_by_band
target_references.notes: Each wage/salary band needs a destination-NZD indicator and source-period bridge. QES average earnings is a macro diagnostic, not an additional hard total over these cells.

target_references.name: msd_main_benefit_recipients_by_program_age
target_references.notes: Count-only administrative cells constrain an explicit receipt/take-up layer. They must never be bound to Axiom full-entitlement outputs or used to force entitlement dollars to equal actual expenditure.

target_references.name: msd_accommodation_supplement_recipients_by_region
target_references.notes: MSD Work and Income regions are not Stats NZ regions. Activation requires an explicit geography bridge and a family-level receipt assignment; the ~44 percent survey estimate remains held-out validation.

target_references.name: msd_nz_super_veterans_pension_recipients
target_references.notes: Recipient stock is a receipt-state target, not an entitlement-output target. Expenditure is validation evidence and stays outside the calibration manifest.

target_references.name: ird_wff_recipient_families
target_references.notes: Cell-pinned IRD administrative count of families with a claim and non-zero final entitlement, not every eligible family and not cash paid. Chronicle owns the September 2025 workbook facts. Activation requires a separate family receipt/claim state and an explicit bridge from tax year ending 2024 to the 2026-27 build basis. Total and average entitlement NZD remain held-out validation, never calibration values.

target_references.name: ird_iwtc_recipient_families
target_references.notes: Cell-pinned IRD administrative count of families with a claim and non-zero final entitlement, not every eligible family and not cash paid. Chronicle owns the September 2025 workbook facts. Activation requires a separate family receipt/claim state and an explicit bridge from tax year ending 2024 to the 2026-27 build basis. Total and average entitlement NZD remain held-out validation, never calibration values.

target_references.name: ird_student_loan_borrowers
target_references.notes: Borrower counts require a reviewed person-level assignment and period definition. Balance dollars are a separate validation or imputation problem.

target_references.name: stats_nz_census_ethnicity_by_age_region
target_references.notes: Ethnicity is multiple-response, not a partition. Chronicle and the target compiler must preserve the publisher's total-response-person convention and must not force mutually exclusive assignment.
